main_axis.headline: You move with others, reading the room and judging when to act; finishing things and earning money take a back seat.
main_axis.body: The lead forces are Companion — your own judgment and peers who move with you — and Rob Wealth — competition among peers, scrambling for resources; together they dwarf everything else. Sitting thin are Eating God and Hurting Officer: the urge to make things and speak out. Wealth, formal pressure, and backing are nowhere in the chart.
main_axis.evidence: Companion carries 13: year stem Gui, plus one from hour branch hidden Gui. Rob Wealth carries 11: hour stem Ren, plus two from month and day branches hidden Ren. Eating God carries 3: year branch hidden Yi. Hurting Officer carries 2: month and day branches hidden Jia. Wealth, Officer-Killings, and Resource families all weigh zero. Water dominates the visible chart at 7, wood at 1; fire, earth, and metal are not shown.

core_loop.headline: Judge the situation → gather with peers → judge again.
core_loop.flow: You size up a situation, call in people you trust, talk through options — but the energy loops back into more sizing-up rather than landing on a finished product. Output is thin, so ideas stay as talk.
core_loop.driver: Companion and Rob Wealth together weigh 24; Output family weighs 5; Wealth, Officer-Killings, and Resource are absent. The Day Master shows special-pattern traits; the chart does not follow the regular support framework.
core_loop.leak:
The cost is that effort rarely becomes money or visible results: you spend the day coordinating, but at month-end there is little to bill or show.
The ten years starting around age 49 (the Wuwu pillar) bring fire and earth into the mix; producing finished work and converting it to income become more natural.
For now, set a 'ship it' rule: every gathering must end with one person assigned to deliver one thing by a named date.
core_loop.evidence: Loop from Companion to Companion: the 24-point Companion and Rob Wealth mass feeds back into itself. Output family (Eating God 3, Hurting Officer 2) is present but thin, so the path from self to product is narrow. Wealth family is zero, so the product-to-income step is missing. Age-49 stretch: Wuwu pillar, stem Wu (earth, would act as Direct Wealth), branch Wu (fire, would act as Direct Officer).

structure_type.name: the collective-judgment type
structure_type.one_line: This chart does not follow the regular framework; the engine withholds favorable-element conclusions. You run on group energy: decisions emerge from talking with peers, not from sitting alone with a plan.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when reading a room and aligning a group toward one direction; weakest when you must produce alone or turn effort into cash.
capability_source.text: You walk into a meeting where five people hold five opinions, and within twenty minutes everyone is nodding at the same next step — that is where the Companion and Rob Wealth mass shows its strength. A concrete scene: the project team is stuck; you call three people, run a quick sync, and suddenly the blockage clears because everyone now sees the same picture.
capability_source.evidence: Strength comes from Companion and Rob Wealth jointly weighing 24. Weakness comes from Output family at 5 (thin) and Wealth family at 0 (missing).

structure_fingerprint: Companion and Rob Wealth run the whole chart; Output is thin, Wealth is missing, and energy loops in the peer zone.
